title: American Greed
description:
S1 — Madoff Behind Bars
Learn what prison life is really like for Bernie Madoff, the perpetrator of the biggest financial scams in US history.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E13 — Million Dollar Prison Kickback
Chris Epps charms his way up the ladder, from prison guard to the top post of Mississippi Department of Corrections Commissioner. Once in office, he and his businessman buddy, Cecil McCrory, set up shop, siphoning kickbacks and bribes.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E1 — All the President's Money?
The best bank robbers in American history hatch an ingenious plan to steal 30 million from a rumored Nixon slush fund, sparking the biggest FBI manhunt since the Kennedy assassination.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E2 — Secrets of the Transy Book Heist
Four clean-cut college students risk it all to become super-thieves by targeting $12 million in rare books in a brash daylight heist that baffles the cops hunting them.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E3 — A Van Full of Dollars
A model bank employee pulls off the second-biggest cash heist in history when he stuffs a work van with $17 million in untraceable cash and flees to Mexico, only to be betrayed by his partners when greed fuels a murder plot.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E4 — The Inside Job
When a violent gang of bank robbers executes a perfect heist, cops don't realize that one of the terrified bank tellers is actually the mastermind behind it all.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E5 — The Picasso Thief
When an irreplaceable Picasso is plucked from a gallery wall, cops know they have just 24 hours to track the thief down before it's likely gone for good.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E6 — The Heist of the Century
TV cameras are there when armed bank robbers take hostages at a large, international bank; police don't realize the robbery only masks a more spectacular heist taking place right under their feet.

A man accused of possessing child porn tries to salvage his relationship with his daughter and her children; deputies contend with an inmate on a mission.

title: Lockup: Cleveland: Extended Stay
description:
S16 E6 — Checkmate
The tenth floor of Cuyahoga County Correction Center contains the Special Response Team, or SERT, a tactical unit trained in the use of riot gear, non-lethal weapons and controlling high-risk inmates.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S5 E9 — Severed Ties
A grim field trip for one inmate, while another offers up clues to an Ohio sex slave mystery; horseplay in the county jail usually doesn't mean fun and games.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S5 E6 — No Boys Allowed
A look at female inmates that start off socializing, but end up creating a lot drama for the staff.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S4 E3 — The Flip Side
A U.S. Marine violates the code and now faces a murder charge; a would-be soccer mom takes up with a violent street gang; an openly gay inmate adheres to the convict code and pays the price.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S4 E6 — Word to the Wise
Using inmates to turn troubled teens away from a life of crime; inmates express their regrets.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — The Damage Done
Inside Florida's toughest maximum-security prison a convicted murderer breaks down the ways of prison, while a young, fresh-faced inmate learns about them; another inmate mails a death threat to the White House and then carries out a shocking act.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Jail Born
A night at the beach in his brother's truck sends a repeat offender back to jail; a Christmas morning hold-up leaves a young man dead and four people in jail with serious charges.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Taking a Hostage
At the Penitentiary of New Mexico, officers are outnumbered, and the inmates are unpredictable, especially in Level 6, the maximum-security facility; it's where the deputy warden says "the worst of the worst" are housed.
